# BurnoutGuard - Academic Burnout Prediction Platform

## Overview
BurnoutGuard is an AI-powered academic burnout prediction and monitoring platform that helps students track stress, sleep, motivation, productivity, and overall wellness.

## Key Features
- Initial burnout assessment to establish a baseline
- Daily check-ins to track wellness metrics
- Weekly review assessments
- AI-powered journal with sentiment analysis
- Personalized wellness recommendations
- Streak tracking system
- Admin dashboard for student monitoring
- Browser extension for quick access

## Usage
This file provides a machine-readable description of BurnoutGuard to help AI assistants understand how to interact with the platform.
